summary: The program addresses the missing source-driven hypothesis generation and search instead of reclassifying scripted fixtures as interpretation evidence. Engineering acceptance, live execution and independent legal evaluation are separate obligations.
findings: Wrong baseline repaired: compare the new generator/search with the prior scripted machinery; existing circulars are development data.
Proxy promotion rejected: model agreement, UCT reward, citation presence and solver consistency cannot grant meaning approval.
Missing stop conditions repaired: shared live allowance, action/root/round/deadline caps, no implicit retries and retained frontier.
Hidden assumptions exposed: one-model contexts are correlated; bounded search is not complete; argument premises still need adjudication.
Environment checked: Python 3.11 and Java 17 exist; Codex CLI supports fresh structured sessions. Trusted live connectivity remains to be tested.
Artifact adequacy: retain input hashes, raw model outputs, actual branches, witnesses and complete uncertainty; not only pass counts.
Preserve unrelated dirty monograph work. Human annotations and bank approval remain external evidence rather than synthetic substitutes.
